evaluations.detail: 100% deterministic JavaScript ES modules; no probabilistic models or remote dependencies used for core validation or hashing.
Reuses existing KAD epistemic classes and acceptance states; avoids premature dependencies or duplicate database architectures.
Canonical documents are DOCUMENT_DERIVED, candidates are OBSERVED / PROPOSED, authority class is CANONICAL_RESEARCH.
Persistence writes to a temporary file before atomic rename, ensuring zero partial or corrupted state.
